module: Cisco EX60 and EX90 TelePresence Systems
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode and with the tamper evident seals installed as indicated in the Security Policy
description: The Cisco TelePresence portfolio creates an immersive, face-to-face experience over the network, empowering you to collaborate with others like never before. Through a powerful combination of technologies and design that allows you and remote participants to feel as if you are all in the same room, the Cisco TelePresence portfolio has the potential to provide great productivity benefits and transform your business. Many organizations are already using it to control costs, make decisions faster, improve customer intimacy, scale scarce resources, and speed products to market.
hardware_versions: EX60 v1 and EX90 v1 with CISCO-FIPSKIT=
